description: Checked readings for characters inside English text (grammar explanations, notes), used when a learner turns characters off. Needed where a character has several readings in the library. "in" limits a reading to one entry (a pattern id, or topic/word); without it the reading applies everywhere.

readings.note: In explanations 呢 is always the demonstrative 'this', not the question particle ne1.
The modal verb 'will; can'; wui2 (a meeting) and wui6 do not occur in the notes.
The classifier for rooms, flats and shops.
The classifier for clothes and matters.
畀人 'by someone'; jan2 is a changed tone used only in some compounds.
'To walk'; hong4 (a line, a trade) does not occur in the notes.
慢 is maan6 'slow'; maan2 is the changed tone in 慢慢.
賣 is maai6 'to sell'; maai2 does not apply here.
The resultative complement, rising tone, as the explanation says.
